summary: Full auth redesign (Welcome → Login OTP-only → Register with Partner/Merchant picker) tested end-to-end. Backend OTP endpoints (8/8 pytest) and frontend flows (10/10 Playwright checks) all pass. No Google button, no demo accounts, no Agent role anywhere. Logout routes back to /(auth)/welcome.
critical_code_review_comments: Customer-block toast text not verified via DOM (still-on-otp state used as proxy). Consider adding data-testid on the auth toast for easier future assertion.

Welcome title 'Reliable Services at Your Door Step' is split across two Text nodes with a line-break; textContent contains newline — worth adding a data-testid on the title heading for robust automated assertions.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 test merchant user (TEST_QA_Merchant, random +9198xxxxxxxx) via backend and 1 via frontend register flow (name 'Test Merchant QA'). Consider periodic cleanup of TEST_ prefixed users.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth screens fully working: /(auth)/welcome, /(auth)/login (login-title 'Welcome Back', login-illustration, login-card, country-code-pill, login-phone-input, send-otp-btn, safe-secure-card, need-help-link, auth-back — no Google, no demo). /(auth)/register (join-pill 'Join AzoApp', register-title 'Create Your Account', pick-partner with popular-badge, pick-merchant, need-help-card, no Agent). OtpFlow: type phone → send-otp-btn → otp-box-0..5 + hidden login-otp-input (dev_otp auto-fills 123456) → verify-otp-btn. Register new user: after verify shows login-name-input + continue-signup-btn. Backend OTP endpoints healthy at /api/auth/send-otp and /api/auth/verify-otp. Logout on partner home uses tab 'More' then [data-testid=more-logout] and lands on /welcome.
